Trace eigenvalue identity and root bounds prove the all-n formula and 3^n+O(2^n). Separate direct simulation exhausts 2,396,672 configurations through n=7; these finite tests are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural first triangular column-coupled majority ring is not the one-dimensional or width-two ladder model: its vertices have four neighbors and tie retention, creating genuinely different local constraints. The theorem gives a complete exact census for every n>=3 and a sharp entropy/log growth base of three per column, including a vanishing fixed-point density. The degree-four-and-under correction factors replace an opaque 64-state trace, supplying a substantive structural finite-width dynamics invariant.
